transcript:
Meeting header:
Date: 2025-06-18
Time: 15:00 UTC
Duration: ~52 minutes
Attendees: Maya, Darren, Rina, Samir, Alice, Carlos, Priya, Ben, Eve

[00:00:00] Maya: okay all right, let's get started. Thanks everyone for joining the IT / Finance / Security ops sync. I think we've got a pretty packed agenda — inventory, billing, SOC2 follow ups. Quick roll call?
[00:00:12] Alice: Alice here.
[00:00:15] Carlos: Carlos on finance.
[00:00:18] Priya: Priya — security.
[00:00:20] Ben: Ben, legal.
[00:00:22] Eve: Eve, procurement.
[00:00:24] Rina: Rina, IT.
[00:00:26] Darren: Darren, platform SE.
[00:00:28] Samir: Samir, finance ops.
[00:00:30] Maya: Cool. First topic, Rina — asset inventory. You flagged the decommission list last week. What changed?
[00:00:40] Rina: yeah so, uh, thanks. I pulled the current inventory, there's about 120 hosts tagged as dev/staging, and roughly 30 that haven't been touched in 3+ months. Part of the problem is inconsistent tagging; some older VMs don't have owner metadata, so we need to run a sweep. I propose a cleanup plan: mark candidates, notify owners, schedule snapshots, then decommission.
[00:01:05] Alice: just to add, backups for a few of those are failing intermittently; we should be careful.
[00:01:10] Darren: can you dump the list to the shared sheet? If we can add last-access timestamps we can prioritize. Also, the KV cache nodes for inference are sensitive — don't decomm without confirmation.
[00:01:25] Rina: absolutely, noted. I'll flag anything in the kvcache tag.
[00:01:30] Maya: Great. Action: Rina to update inventory with owner and backup status. Target date?
[00:01:36] Rina: aiming 2025-07-01.
[00:01:40] Maya: Perfect.
[00:01:44] Maya: Next, finance. Samir? How's the cloud billing reconciliation coming along?
[00:01:50] Samir: We finished the preliminary allocate run. The thing is, trailing credits and marketplace charges are showing up in odd cost centers. For example, some Dedicated cluster costs are still on the general infra cost center instead of being attributed to the Dedicated contract. We're reconciling with cost allocation tags.
[00:02:10] Carlos: is this causing variance on the monthly forecast?
[00:02:13] Samir: small variance, maybe 6-8% this month. Need to finalize mapping and push corrections. I'll share a month-to-date breakdown by Friday.
[00:02:22] Carlos: please include per-model inference costs if you can, even if approximate — helps product chargebacks.
[00:02:28] Samir: will do, though model-level is fuzzy, we can approximate by cluster metrics.
[00:02:33] Maya: Also, procurement — Eve, any updates on Dedicated capacity contract timeline?
[00:02:38] Eve: We're waiting on Ben for legal redlines; procurement is ready to engage with the vendor once legal clears. Suggested milestone: finalize redlines by next week, aim to sign the SOW in two weeks.
[00:02:50] Ben: I posted comments on the doc this morning; the main issues are indemnity and data residency clauses. I need procurement to confirm acceptable SLA language.
[00:02:58] Eve: noted.
[00:03:00] Maya: Good. Moving to Security — Priya, SOC2 evidence status?
[00:03:05] Priya: We ran through the control map; most docs exist but evidence gaps are lingering on change management and some IAM reviews. Also need KMS rotation logs for a couple services. I've started a checklist and will share it.
[00:03:20] Darren: on KMS, do we have a defined rotation cadence? For customer-facing keys we use the KMS with automated rotation but some internal HSM-managed keys haven't been rotated in a year.
[00:03:32] Priya: yeah that's the issue — internal keys need a rotation plan. For private deployment customers we also need proof of key access reviews.
[00:03:40] Rina: For the on-prem packages, we store customer pointers to keys in the vault — we should ensure we have audit logs for every access.
[00:03:47] Maya: Let's prioritize 1) KMS rotation plan 2) audit log collection 3) IAM review. Priya will drive.
[00:03:56] Priya: I'll circulate the checklist by next Wednesday, I think 2025-06-25 is doable.
[00:04:02] Maya: Great. A note: legal and audit teams will want SSO/SAML proof — Ben, can you confirm what artifacts you need?
[00:04:10] Ben: screenshots of SAML assertions, IdP configs, and a recent access review report. If we have RBAC role mappings exported that's useful.
[00:04:20] Priya: we can produce those; Rina can pull the role mapping from the admin console.
[00:04:24] Rina: yes, should be straightforward.
[00:04:28] Maya: Ok, procurement/finance cross-item — we had a question about how Dedicated billing will surface in our invoices vs the reserved capacity contract. Samir?
[00:04:36] Samir: It depends on vendor billing. If it's a reserved monthly commit, we'll see a vendor invoice that needs to be allocated to the Dedicated contract cost center; usage overages might show as separate line items. We'll map after contract signing.
[00:04:48] Eve: we should add a clause for overage notifications so finance gets alerted at threshold.
[00:04:52] Ben: yeah add a 75% and 90% alert threshold in SOW terms.
[00:04:56] Maya: Good. There's also the technical deep dive request from security about the private deployment audit — Darren, you said you'd schedule one?
[00:05:03] Darren: yes, I'll set up a technical deep dive with infra and SEs. Targeting week of 2025-06-23. We'll walk through network diagrams, KMS/HSM flow, and backup/restore proof points.
[00:05:15] Priya: can we include the QA folks? They need to validate backup restores.
[00:05:20] Rina: I'll invite the ops/backup owners.
[00:05:23] Maya: Sounds good.
[00:05:26] Maya: Quick check — any immediate risks?
[00:05:30] Alice: A couple of dev staging hosts have credentials stored in plaintext in a config repo. We need a sweep.
[00:05:36] Priya: wow. Ok, that's high priority. Rina, can ops run a credentials scan?
[00:05:40] Rina: yes, we have a scanner but it needs the repo token. I'll coordinate with product to get read access.
[00:05:46] Maya: Make that an action item.
[00:05:49] Samir: On the finance side, one note — marketplace charges are sometimes mis-tagged when engineers spin up POCs; maybe tighten the onboarding to remind teams to tag resources.
[00:05:59] Darren: we can add a pre-provisioning check in the self-serve portal to enforce tags. Low-effort change.
[00:06:06] Carlos: For reporting, Samir, if you can include historical variances we can present to leadership next Monday.
[00:06:12] Samir: will prioritize.
[00:06:16] Maya: Any blockers on SOC2 evidence collection?
[00:06:19] Priya: only the change mgmt logs — some systems didn't retain full logs last quarter. We're capturing now, but auditors might ask for historical info. We'll note the gap.
[00:06:30] Ben: legal recommends documenting the gap and the remediation plan; auditors tend to accept documented remediation if reasonable.
[00:06:36] Maya: okay. Let's talk timeline: when should we reconvene? Two weeks?
[00:06:41] Alice: two weeks works.
[00:06:43] Priya: two weeks fine.
[00:06:45] Maya: Schedule next check-in 2025-07-02 same time.
[00:06:49] Ben: noted.
[00:06:52] Maya: Any other items — procurement, legal, ops?
[00:06:56] Eve: Just please confirm the acceptance criteria for Dedicated SLA — procurement needs a short list to negotiate.
[00:07:02] Maya: We'll capture SLA targets: 99.9% uptime, p95 latency targets (TBD by SE), and escalation contact. Darren to draft p95 targets and we'll circulate.
[00:07:12] Darren: I'll draft and add to the SOW comments.
[00:07:16] Maya: Good. Quick parking lot: benchmark request from finance for per-token cost — Darren, can you provide a rough model-level estimate?
[00:07:24] Darren: yes, but model quantization and batching change numbers a lot. I'll give a baseline and note assumptions.
[00:07:30] Samir: we just need approximations to model forecasts.
[00:07:33] Maya: Perfect. Any final clarifications?
[00:07:37] Alice: Could we get the asset inventory shared sheet link in chat?
[00:07:40] Rina: I'll post after the call.
[00:07:42] Maya: OK. Recap of action items and owners — Rina will update inventory by 2025-07-01, Samir will share MTD cloud spend by 2025-06-20, Priya will circulate SOC2 checklist by 2025-06-25, Darren to schedule private-deploy deep dive week of 2025-06-23, Ben to review procurement redlines by 2025-06-27.
[00:08:02] Maya: Thanks everyone. We'll follow up in Asana and calendar invites. Meeting adjourned.

Notes: transcription had a few overlapped sections around the roll call and the procurement legal discussion where speaker labels may be off. Some product names referenced loosely (Dedicated, KV cache) and occasional word swap (kvcache vs k v cache).
